args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and FIN-212
require ROUND_HALF_EVEN. This made the nightly build fail because
tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.

## Change
- Import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `amount.quantize(...)` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing
- CI run for this branch passed (run `ci-0001`, commit `08d3cd5986`).
